scope: A physical AC1027 source witness confirms the direct NOD ACAD_IMAGE_VARS owner shape. The adapter now admits that exact direct-owner path, while preserving the existing nested dictionary path. implementation.profile: Same-revision AC1027 only. A record must be reached once through either one complete NOD-owned dictionary or exactly one NOD ACAD_IMAGE_VARS entry that directly targets the typed RASTERVARIABLES record. The direct route requires its parent handle to equal the NOD handle. Both routes retain the existing no-reactor, no-extension-dictionary, no-data-storage, no-EED/XDATA, unique-handle, source CLASS/frame, and int16 modeled-field constraints. Group 90 values other than 0 are refused.
implementation.graphOutput: The NOD traversal inventory recognizes a direct RASTERVARIABLES target only when the root key is ACAD_IMAGE_VARS, the object is staged by the extension graph, and its typed parent is the NOD.
